article.title: Electronic form to be exclusive, alternative or in addition to physical form.
article.content: The Central Government may also provide in the rules made under section 398 and section 399 that the electronic form for the purposes specified in these sections shall be exclusive, or in the alternative or in addition to the physical form, therefor.
article.html:
400Electronic form to be exclusive, alternative or in addition to physical form.

Section 400 · Chapter XXIV · page 229 of the Act

The Central Government may also provide in the rules made under section 398 and section 399 that the electronic form for the purposes specified in these sections shall be exclusive, or in the alternative or in addition to the physical form, therefor.
